title: fix(i18n): Studio trackHistory switch describes the v3 timeline, not a History tab
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

Fixes #27544

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 对象设置里 trackHistory 开关的标题和说明（英文、中文），不再写「历史标签页」，改为说字段变更并入记录时间线的「变更」筛选；另修正 plugin-detail 里两处描述页签的注释。
- 为什么改：v3 记录页已没有 History 标签页，spec 的 enable.trackHistory 说明已改，开关文案还停在旧页面，作者打开开关时会被误导。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案和注释，开关的行为、键名和保存内容都不变；回滚即还原这三个文件。
- 先看：ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts（capTrackHistory 两条）、zh.ts 同两条、buildDefaultPageSchema.ts 的 buildDefaultTabs 注释。
- 两分钟验证：打开 Studio 任一对象的设置，看「能力开关」里 trackHistory 那一行，应显示「字段变更历史」并说明并入时间线的「变更」筛选。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `engine.studio.settings.capTrackHistory` / `capTrackHistoryDesc` (studio namespace, `en` and `zh`, the only two catalogues that carry the keys; every other language falls back to `en`): the label drops "History tab" for "Field change history (trackHistory)" / 「字段变更历史(trackHistory)」, and the description reuses the spec's `enable.trackHistory` sentence: on the default record page the record's field changes join its one timeline stream, under its Changes filter. The per-field pairing and the "audit capture is always on" clauses are kept.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, comments only: the `buildDefaultTabs` docblock now names the tabs it emits today (Details always, then Timeline / Related / Approvals when they have content, Timeline second for a worked object and last otherwise), and the `details` slot note names Timeline / Related / Approvals as the other tabs instead of Related / Activity / History.
- Root changeset: `@object-ui/i18n` patch. `plugin-detail` changes comments only and publishes nothing new.

## Why

The spec's `enable.trackHistory` describe text moved to the v3 record page: there is no History tab, field changes are a filter of the one timeline stream. The Studio switch an author reads while turning the flag on still promised a History tab.

## Acceptance notes

- No test pins these strings: the switch is found by its `cap-trackHistory` test id in `ObjectSettingsPanel.test.tsx`, and the studio namespace sits outside the all-locales parity suite by construction (its own index docblock). `en-zh-key-parity` holds the key sets, which are unchanged.
- The spec's sentence also says an authored page's `record:history` / `record:activity` block shows field changes without reading the flag. The switch copy keeps to the default page so it stays one line; the spec carries the full text.
- No behaviour change, so no ablation.
